contact.basis: Fixed dry pavement4moutside original named visitor-centre seaward facade midpoint before any terrain acquisition. Compound floor grades/thresholds and host shore/road datum remain approximate, no terrain flattening/fitting.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in signed native visitor-centre seaward facade frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.2.5m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Composite urban heights may include/interpolate structure and vegetation; exact court/wall foot classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
